## Change

Describe the user-visible problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related
issue. Include migration notes for public API changes.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant behavior, cancellation and failure paths checked.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes, or documentation-only link checks are recorded.
- [ ] Public behavior, TSDoc and known limits documented.
- [ ] User-visible changes added to the **Unreleased** section of `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] Browser interaction or performance evidence included when applicable.

## Risks and limits

Record remaining compatibility, performance or rollout limitations.
